* **YouTube Music:** Add `Playlist track tap action` patch ([1a3d162](https://github.com/Rosaldivo/rosaldivo-morphe-patches/commit/1a3d162bf6a57e7982d6987339c78bb0b702d679))

patches.name: Playlist track tap action
patches.description: Plays only the tapped track of a playlist or album, or adds it to the queue, instead of replacing the queue with the whole playlist.

options.description: What tapping a track inside a playlist or album does.
